title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: The Anthem, Washington, DC | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at The Anthem in Washington, DC, USA, on 28 September 2026.

It was the third show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s fall tour of the USA, which lasted for nine dates in September and October 2026.

Starr had previously performed at The Anthem on 17 September 2024.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’
  • ‘I’m The Greatest’
  • ‘Yellow Submarine’
  • ‘Cut The Cake’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Octopus’s Garden’
  • ‘No No Song’
  • ‘Choose Love’
  • ‘Overkill’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Africa’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Work To Do’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’
  • ‘Who Can It Be Now?’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
